name: New line - Pixel 10a $8.99 - Value 2.0
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: frugal student.
scripted_messages: Hey. I need an affordable phone, so I'm looking at the Pixel 10a at $8.99 a month. I'd be adding one new line on Value 2.0. What's the total I'd pay each month, and how much high speed data do I get?
Thanks. What happens after the 5GB runs out?
And is the $8.99 locked in for the whole 36 months?
Ok, that works for me. Thanks, you were fast and friendly.
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 6: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 7: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
